rules.statement: A court cannot convert an action filed under the summary procedure to a regular procedure, and it cannot disregard the special procedure stipulated under the Debt Recovery Act and follow the regular procedure in an action filed under the Debt Recovery Act.
rules.supporting_quote: Although some requirements in procedural law can be dispensed with upon the agreement of the parties, mandatory requirements in procedural law cannot be circumvented by the consent of the parties. Thus, a court has no power or discretion to convert an action filed under the summary procedure to a regular procedure.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 4(1) of the Debt Recovery Act No. 02 of 1990 as amended by Act No. 9 of 1994
